newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - SigmaTron buy repeated.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - SigmaTron buy repeated.

text.p: -- National Securities analyst Steven Kornfeld said Tuesday he reiterated his buy rating on SigmaTron International Inc.

-- On Monday, the company reported fiscal third quarter earnings of $0.25 a share, down from $0.26 a year ago, and below National Securities' estimate of $0.27. Earnings per share dropped due to an increase in shares outstanding, while quarterly net income rose to $757,000 from $709,000.
-- Kornfeld said he cut his fiscal 1997 estimate to $1.15 a share from $1.17 to reflect higher than expected shares outstanding due to the exercise of stock options.
-- Product mix for the quarter led to a drop in the gross margin to 13.1 percent, below the company's historical and projected levels of 14 to 15 percent, Kornfeld said in a report.

-- "At its two domestic plans, SigmaTron has run into capacity constraints and will expand its operations in Mexico and possibly at its Chicago area headquarters," Kornfeld said. "While expansion costs may impact profitability in the short run, we applaud management's move to improve efficiency and add capacity for the longer term."

-- In the last week, SigmaTron's share price has dropped from $24 to $16, where it closed on Monday. Kornfeld blamed "momentum investors (who) have punished the company for scarcely missing its EPS (earnings per share) number."
-- "At 13.9 (times) and 10.2 (times) our FY97 and FY98 estimates, we believe at $16 (SigamTron) presents an opportunity for investors who missed the last price appreciation," Kornfeld said.
